description: Add an interactive requirements-interview mode to the stack creation flow. When no project path exists, @analyzer asks structured questions to gather requirements and synthesizes them into agent recommendations — closing the gap identified in the previous task.

steps.task: Design the requirements interview questionnaire. Define: (1) the ordered list of questions covering project domain, languages/frameworks, workstreams, testing strategy, scale/team size, and key integrations; (2) a JSON data model for capturing answers (`RequirementsProfile`); (3) a mapping from answer patterns to agent recommendations (e.g. 'uses FastAPI' → recommend @fastapi-backend). Output as a markdown design doc at `framework/docs/requirements-interview-design.md`.

output.summary: Created framework/docs/requirements-interview-design.md with 4-phase questionnaire, RequirementsProfile JSON schema, answer→agent mapping table, interview flow, and example session

steps.task: Update `.claude/agents/analyzer.agent.md` to add an 'Interview Mode' section. This mode activates when the user provides no project path (or uses `--interview` flag). It should: (1) present questions from the design doc sequentially; (2) parse answers into a `RequirementsProfile`; (3) map profile to agent recommendations using the same output format as file-analysis mode; (4) make clear that this is the entry point for greenfield projects. Preserve all existing sections.

Update `.claude/commands/create-stack.md` slash command to support requirements-interview mode. Add: (1) detection logic — if no path argument or `--interview` flag, route to `@analyzer` interview mode instead of file-analysis mode; (2) document the full interview → analysis → write flow in the command doc; (3) add an example showing `'/create-stack --interview'` usage. Preserve existing path-based and description-based flows.

Create `framework/scripts/requirements-interview.py` — a CLI script that runs the requirements interview interactively in the terminal. It should: (1) present questions from `RequirementsProfile` schema one at a time with prompts; (2) accept free-text and multi-choice answers; (3) output a `requirements-profile.json` file; (4) optionally pipe output to `task-executor.py` to trigger `@analyzer` with the profile. Include `--dry-run` and `--output` flags. Add usage to CLAUDE.md scripts table.

Validate all modified agent files against the agent schema: run `python framework/scripts/validate-agent.py --all` and fix any frontmatter issues in the updated `.claude/agents/analyzer.agent.md`. Also verify the new requirements-interview-design.md follows the framework's documentation conventions.

Commit all changes with a conventional commit message: `feat(create-stack): add requirements-interview mode for greenfield stack creation`. Include in commit: framework/docs/requirements-interview-design.md, .claude/agents/analyzer.agent.md, .claude/commands/create-stack.md, framework/scripts/requirements-interview.py, and CLAUDE.md if updated.
